name: Mechanism pressure-lockout interface
summary: Carries the manufacturer's defined low-pressure blocking state to the command logic.
description: Carries the manufacturer's defined low-pressure blocking state to the command logic. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Pressure lockout contact” at the input and “Blocked-operation state” at the output. Different operations may have different lockout conditions.
